- **Turns used**: 5

- **Notes**: Edges sourced from both `dependencies` and `peerDependencies` fields in each `package.json`. The `@nestjs/common` package has no `@nestjs/*` dependencies (it is the root dependency of the graph). All 9 packages under `test-repo/packages/` have `@nestjs/` scoped names. Node IDs use the short name (suffix after `@nestjs/`) per the spec; the `platform-socket.io` node ID includes the dot, which is valid in Mermaid when used as a bare node reference in edge declarations.
mini_task_spec:
Read each `package.json` file found at `test-repo/packages/*/package.json`. For every package whose `name` field starts with `@nestjs/`, collect all `@nestjs/*` entries from both its `dependencies` and `peerDependencies` fields and treat them as directed dependency edges (from the package to the dependency). This gives a directed graph with 9 nodes (one per `@nestjs/*` package in `packages/`) and some set of edges.

Using the graphexport brick (`ge_mermaid`), export this dependency graph as a Mermaid `graph TB` diagram. Use the short name (the text after `@nestjs/`) as each node's ID. Report **only the edge lines** of the resulting Mermaid diagram (lines containing `-->`), one per line, sorted alphabetically first by source node ID, then by target node ID within the same source, in the exact format `    <source> --> <target>` (4-space indent). Do not include the `graph TB` header or node-declaration lines in the answer.
